title: Handoff Routine
reference: repeat 3 { F1 radio turn_left turn_left } def DASH { repeat 2 { listen F1 turn_left turn_left } listen F1 } def F1 { pick_up turn_left turn_left drop }
hints: Both bots pass a crate the same way: lift, turn round, set down. One routine for both.
F1: lift, turn left twice, drop. LoopBot radios after each drop; DASH waits for radio before each F1.
repeat 3 { F1 radio turn_left turn_left } def DASH { repeat 2 { listen F1 turn_left turn_left } listen F1 } def F1 { pick_up turn_left turn_left drop }

story.intro: BULWARK: "An evidence line! Lift, turn, set it down. Same moves for both of you, so write them once."
